Type: low flush-mount ceiling light
Use: general ceiling light; bedroom, hallway, living room, home office
Style: contemporary, classic, minimalist
Materials: frosted white glass diffuser, brushed nickel metal rim
Colors: soft white, cool silver
Shape: shallow round dome of frosted glass under a wide stepped metal band, very low profile, sits flat to the ceiling, unobtrusive
Feel: clean, bright, simple
Goes with: white or grey walls, chrome and nickel accents, light wood; contemporary or transitional rooms

product.name: Ravenna Home Casual Flush Mount, 3"H, Brushed Nickel
product.description: 11"W x 11"D x 3"H This casual design ceiling light fixture is flush mounted and combines modern beauty and function. 23-watt, 1100-lumen flickering bulb; dimmable with triac dimmer switch Assemble in 15-30 minutes Damp rated
